_comment: Public App Store metadata for the six landing-page apps.

apps.name: Mala
apps.privacy_body:
## The short version

Mala is a local-first repetition-practice app. It has no account, ads, analytics, tracking, third-party SDKs, or developer-operated network service.

## Information stored on your device

Mala stores the practice labels you create, your preferences, an in-progress practice, and practice history in the app's local storage. This information is used only to provide the app's features and is not sent to the developer.

## Your choices

You can delete individual history entries, clear all history, and delete custom labels inside the app. Deleting the app removes its active local app data from the device. Apple-managed device backups, if enabled, are governed by Apple and your device settings.

## Permissions and purchases

Mala does not request location, camera, microphone, contacts, or photo-library access. Version 1 has no purchase flow.

## Changes

If Mala's data practices change, this policy and its App Store privacy disclosures will be updated before the changed behavior is released.

apps.name: Anjali
apps.privacy_body:
## The short version

Anjali does not require an account and does not send personal data to the developer. It has no developer-operated backend, analytics, advertising, tracking, third-party SDKs, or purchases. Prayer content is bundled with the app and works offline.

## Information stored on your device

Anjali stores only the information needed to remember your experience:

- script and prayer-mode preferences;
- your chosen ishta devata and favorite moments;
- saved prayers and completed-prayer activity; and
- whether optional reminders are enabled.

Preferences are stored in the app's local settings, while saved and completed prayers use Apple's on-device SwiftData storage. The developer cannot view this information.

## Notifications

If you enable a dawn, sunset, or sleep reminder, Anjali asks for notification permission and schedules the reminder locally through iOS. It does not use a push-notification server. You can disable reminders in Anjali or revoke permission in iOS Settings.

## Permissions and third parties

Anjali does not request location, camera, microphone, contacts, or photo-library access. It contains no analytics, advertising, attribution, or crash-reporting SDK.

## Deletion

Anjali has no remote account or server-side record to delete. Deleting the app removes its active local app data from the device. Apple-managed device backups, if enabled, are governed by Apple and your device settings.

## Changes

If Anjali's data practices change, this policy and its App Store privacy disclosures will be updated before the changed behavior is released.

apps.name: Roam
apps.privacy_body:
## The short version

Roam is a local-first travel map. It does not require an account, and the developer does not operate a Roam server or receive your saved travel history. Roam does not use advertising, advertising identifiers, cross-app tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs.

## Location information stored on your device

If you enable tracking, Roam receives precise location samples from Apple's Core Location service, including in the background when you grant Always access. Roam uses those samples to match your position against bundled geographic boundaries.

The app stores local records that can include exact first-entry and last-seen latitude and longitude, ZIP Code Area visits and timestamps, duration, detection source and confidence, area names, notes, favorites and archive state, preferences, and diagnostic event-log rows that may include coordinates.

Diagnostic event logging is enabled by default and can be disabled in Settings. Roam also stores MetricKit performance and diagnostic reports locally when iOS supplies them.

## Apple services and purchases

Roam uses Core Location for location delivery, MapKit for Apple map content, MetricKit for platform diagnostics, and StoreKit for the optional one-time Roam Plus purchase. Apple may process information needed to provide those services under Apple's policies. Roam does not upload its saved visit database to the developer.

## Exporting and sharing

JSON and CSV exports may contain exact coordinates, timestamps, notes, and optional diagnostic event logs. Files remain local until you choose a destination in Apple's share sheet. The recipient or selected service controls a copy after sharing. The separate coverage card shows aggregate coverage rather than exact routes.

## Your choices

You can decline or revoke location permission, use foreground-only access, disable background tracking, turn off diagnostic event logging, and delete tracked history. Without location permission, automatic visit tracking does not operate.

## Deletion

Delete All Data removes tracked areas, visits, and diagnostic event-log rows. It does not remove saved settings, export files already generated, or local MetricKit report files. Deleting the app removes its active local app data from the device. Shared copies, Apple purchase records, and Apple-managed device backups are outside Roam's control.

## Changes

This policy and the App Store privacy disclosures will be updated before Roam changes its location, networking, analytics, account, or sharing behavior.

apps.name: Svara
apps.privacy_body:
## The short version

Svara does not require an account and does not send your practice data or reflections to a developer-operated server. It contains no advertising, developer analytics, or cross-app tracking.

## Information stored on your device

Svara stores a display name for your local profile; practice sessions, lessons, streaks, points, festival progress, saved festivals, and achievements; reminder choices and times; and private reflections you choose to write.

Reflections are stored as a local app file. The production app has no configured Firebase, CloudKit, or developer backend that receives this information.

## Notifications

If you enable practice reminders, Svara requests notification permission and schedules morning and evening notifications locally through iOS. Reminder settings are not sent to a server. You can disable them in Svara or in iOS Settings.

## Purchases

Svara Plus monthly and yearly subscriptions and the lifetime purchase use Apple's StoreKit and App Store services. Apple processes the transaction; Svara reads verified entitlement state to determine which features are available. Apple's policies govern purchase processing and retention.

## Sharing and external links

When you choose to share festival content, Svara opens Apple's system share sheet and you select the destination. The app also provides links to its privacy policy, terms, website, and support contact. Those destinations open through system apps and are governed by their respective providers.

## Permissions

Svara does not request location, contacts, photos, microphone, camera, or health-data access. Audio included with the app is played locally.

## Deletion

Svara currently has no in-app full-data reset. Deleting the app removes its active local app data from the device. Apple purchase records and Apple-managed device backups are governed by Apple.

## Changes

This policy and the App Store disclosures will be updated before Svara adds an account, developer backend, cloud sync, analytics, advertising, or other changed data handling.

apps.name: Hindsight
apps.privacy_body:
## The short version

Hindsight is a private, on-device decision journal. Version 1.0 has no account, backend, cloud sync, developer telemetry, advertising, or third-party analytics. Your forecasts, confidence, reflections, and Insights stay on your device, and the developer cannot see them.

## Information stored on your device

Hindsight stores the content you create so the app can work: forecast or decision statements, your chosen 0-100% confidence, optional reasoning, categories, options, and notes, creation and review dates, recorded outcomes and reflections, and derived on-device calibration results. It also stores local drafts and preferences such as onboarding completion, appearance, reminder choices, and haptic settings.

## On-device Insights

Calibration and other Insights - observed outcome rate, average stated confidence, calibration gap, confidence bands, and Brier score - are calculated locally from eligible records. They are never uploaded or used for advertising, profiling, or developer analytics.

## Notifications

If you enable review reminders, Hindsight schedules local notifications through iOS. Reminder text is generic and never includes your forecast or journal content. You can deny or revoke permission in iOS Settings. Hindsight does not use a remote push-notification server.

## Exporting and deletion

You can export your journal as JSON or PDF; files are created locally and go only to the destination you pick in the iOS share sheet. Example records are kept separate from personal records and are excluded from your personal export. You can delete individual records or clear Hindsight data inside the app, and deleting the app removes its local data from the device, subject to Apple's device and backup behavior.

## Children

Hindsight is a judgment tool designed for adults and is not directed to children under 13.

## Changes

This policy will be reviewed and updated before Hindsight introduces any account, server, synchronization, telemetry, social feature, or other remote data practice.

apps.name: AuraFit
apps.privacy_body:
## The short version

AuraFit does not collect your data. There is no account, no server, no analytics, and nothing to buy — every feature is free. Every photo you scan is analyzed on your iPhone and stored only on your iPhone. The app has no networking code of its own, so there is nowhere for your photos or scores to go.

## What the app stores, and where

Everything below lives in AuraFit's private app sandbox on your device. Deleting the app deletes all of it.

- Photos you capture or import for a scan are kept as JPEG files in the app's Documents directory. They never leave your device.
- Scores, tips, style match, and color palette are kept in a local SwiftData database. They never leave your device.
- Scorecard images and reveal clips you generate are kept in the app's Documents directory. They leave your device only if you share or save them yourself.
- Your preferences (haptics, sound, auto-save) are kept in the local SwiftData database. They never leave your device.

## How photos are analyzed

Analysis runs entirely on your device. Apple's Vision framework estimates body pose and person segmentation, Core Image measures image and color signals, and AuraFit uses a deterministic color-based heuristic for the closest style match. No learned outfit-classifier model is bundled in this release. Nothing is uploaded for processing.

Scores are subjective guidance about an outfit and a photograph. They are not a measurement of any person, and the app does not identify, recognize, or profile anyone.

## What we do not do

- We do not collect, transmit, sell, or share your personal data.
- We do not use analytics, advertising, attribution, or crash-reporting SDKs.
- We do not track you across apps or websites. AuraFit does not use App Tracking Transparency because it has nothing to track.
- We do not create accounts, and we never ask for your name, email, or phone number.
- We do not sell anything inside the app. There is nothing to buy, so the app holds no payment information of any kind.
- We include no third-party libraries or code.

The app's privacy manifest declares no collected data types, no tracking, and no tracking domains. It also declares the approved file-timestamp reason used to remove old, unreferenced media from AuraFit's own app container.

## Permissions the app asks for

- Camera — only to capture the photo you are about to scan. Frames are analyzed on device and the camera is not used in the background.
- Import from Photos — uses Apple's system photo picker. AuraFit receives only the image you select and does not request broad Photo Library read access.
- Photo Library (add) — only when you tap Save or turn on auto-save, so scorecards and reveal clips can be written to your library.

You can revoke any of these in iOS Settings. Declining camera access does not block the app; you can still import from your library.

## Sharing is always your choice

Scorecards and reveal clips are shared only when you tap Share or Save and choose a destination in the iOS share sheet. Whatever you send then travels under the privacy policy of the app or service you sent it to, not this one.

## Links that leave the app

Terms of Use opens Apple's standard licence page in your system browser. Opening a link sends no AuraFit data along with it. It is the only outbound destination in the app.

## Children

AuraFit is not directed at children and collects no data from anyone, including children.

## Your rights

Because no data ever reaches us, there is nothing for us to look up, export, correct, or delete on your behalf. You hold the only copy. Settings > Delete All Fits removes every saved scan and its images immediately, and deleting the app removes everything else.

## Changes to this policy

If the app's data practices ever change, this policy and the policy screen inside the app will be updated before the change ships.
apps.support_body:
AuraFit is a local-first iPhone app for subjective outfit and photo guidance. It does not use an account or upload your selected photos for analysis. Every feature is free: there is nothing to buy inside the app.

Support requests are answered by the developer from the mailbox below; there is no ticketing system or account to sign in to.

## Getting a result

- Open the Scan tab.
- Choose Open Camera to take a photo, or Import from Library to choose one with the system photo picker.
- For the most useful guidance, use a clear, full-body photo with one visible person, even front-facing light, and a simple background.

AuraFit's score and tips are subjective styling and photography guidance about the outfit and photo. They are not a measurement of a person, health, attractiveness, identity, or worth.

## Camera and Photos permissions

- AuraFit requests Camera access only after you choose Open Camera. If it is off, the Camera Access Needed message offers Open Settings to change the iPhone setting or Use Library to continue without Camera access.
- Import from Library uses Apple's system photo picker. AuraFit receives only the image you select; it does not ask for broad Photo Library read access.
- AuraFit requests Photo Library (add) access only when you tap Save or enable Auto-save exports to Photos in Settings. You can decline it and still use AuraFit.

## Saved fits and exports

Completed scans are saved locally in History on the iPhone. You can favorite or delete an individual fit from its History context menu. To remove every saved fit and its images, open Settings > Data > Delete All Fits, then choose Delete Everything. This cannot be undone. Deleting the app also removes its local app data.

Share Scorecard opens the iPhone share sheet. Save writes an export to Photos only after you choose that action and grant permission. Any shared item is handled by the destination you select.

## Scorecard styles and reveal clips

All three scorecard styles (Classic, Streetwear, Soft Luxury) and the reveal clip are available to everyone. Pick a style on the result screen; Reveal Clip renders a short video of the score animating in and opens the share sheet.

## Privacy and terms

The privacy policy is published at [priyanshchordia.com/apps/aurafit/privacy/](/apps/aurafit/privacy/) and is also readable inside the app under Settings > Privacy Policy. Terms of Use in Settings opens Apple's standard licence agreement.

## What to include in a support request

Do not send source photos, Apple IDs, payment details, or other sensitive data. For a technical issue, include the app version/build, iPhone model, iOS version, the exact steps, expected and actual result, and whether it repeats. Screenshots or recordings are optional and should not include private photos unless you deliberately choose to share them by email.
